items.title: Advantest confirms personal data stolen in ransomware attack
items.summary: Japanese chip-test equipment maker Advantest confirmed on Oct 7 that attackers stole personal data in a ransomware attack first detected in February, a roughly 233-day gap between detection and disclosure.

items.title: Osaka Metropolitan University: about 500 servers offline, classes cancelled
items.summary: Around 500 servers went offline, the campus network and several university systems were unavailable and classes were cancelled; data on at least 130,000 students and staff may have been exposed.

items.title: City of Vicksburg, Mississippi shuts down computer systems
items.summary: The city temporarily shut down its computer systems after a cyberattack; police, fire and 911 stayed operational while possible access to personal or confidential information is investigated.

items.title: Warlock group uses compromised SharePoint servers for ransomware deployment
items.summary: Check Point reports Warlock gained initial access through compromised SharePoint servers, disabled endpoint protection on dozens of systems and deployed ransomware across at least 33 hosts in a single intrusion.

items.title: Spanish police arrest suspected KillSec operator, seize leak site
items.summary: Spanish police arrested a 16-year-old suspected of running the KillSec ransomware group, and authorities seized the group's servers and leak site (reported Oct 1).

ransomware.note: Thin news day for named victims: the Osaka and Vicksburg items come from an aggregator and are not yet confirmed as ransomware by the victims; the standard search returned nothing dated October.

items.title: Yandex Cloud disrupted after drone attack on Sasovo data center
items.summary: Downdetector logged more than 1,300 reports on Oct 8 for Yandex Cloud, Documents and Tables; Yandex attributed the disruption to a drone attack and fire at a data center, which it halted.

items.title: Azure: two incidents hit 18 regions in 40 hours
items.summary: Between Sep 29 and Oct 1 Azure logged two separate outages that took gateway services offline across 18 regions, including nearly six hours of Azure OpenAI disruption in Sweden.

items.title: Cloudflare network performance issues in Columbus
items.summary: Cloudflare classified an Oct 7 network performance incident in Columbus as major and resolved it at 11:51 UTC; several other minor regional incidents were logged the same week.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center intermittently inaccessible
items.summary: Admins were intermittently unable to reach the Microsoft 365 admin center starting Oct 5 at 22:28, an incident lasting about 2 hours 58 minutes.

outage.note: No major AWS or Google Cloud outage found for October; third-party trackers conflict on a minor AWS degradation on Oct 6. Most items here come from status trackers, not provider post-incident reports.

items.title: FortiBleed attackers locking victims out of Fortinet devices
items.summary: An active campaign against Fortinet devices is creating new accounts and deleting existing accounts and passwords to block legitimate access; SOCRadar counts roughly 86,644 exposed devices in 194 countries.

items.title: CISA adds Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-88779 to KEV
items.summary: CISA added a Citrix NetScaler memory-buffer flaw on Oct 4 with an Oct 7 remediation due date and forensic triage required under BOD 26-04.

items.title: CISA adds two chainable Zammad flaws to KEV
items.summary: On Oct 2 CISA added CVE-2026-102489 (session fixation) and CVE-2026-102490 (improper privilege management, local escalation to root) in the Zammad helpdesk platform; the two can be chained.

items.title: KEV additions in 2026 already exceed all of 2025
items.summary: A vendor analysis counts 247 KEV entries added from Jan 1 to Oct 1, 2026 versus 245 in all of 2025, with 91 of 114 entries since BOD 26-04 carrying a three-day deadline; figures are secondary and unverified against CISA's catalog.

cyber.note: No newly disclosed non-ransomware data breach dated October surfaced in today's searches.

items.title: Hurricane Isaias heading for the northern Gulf Coast
items.summary: Isaias, the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026, is forecast to be a strong hurricane at landfall Friday night or early Saturday; a Storm Surge Warning runs from the Mouth of the Mississippi River to Steinhatchee, Florida, with inland flash flooding possible across the Southeast into the weekend.

items.title: Earthquake: 102 km NE of Norsup, Vanuatu
items.summary: A magnitude 6.3 earthquake struck on Oct 8; USGS alert level green, no tsunami flag.

items.title: Earthquake: 92 km NNW of Aleneva, Alaska
items.summary: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake struck on Oct 6; USGS alert level green, no tsunami flag.

items.title: Earthquake: 5 km NNE of Korumburra, Australia
items.summary: A magnitude 4.7 earthquake struck on Oct 2; USGS alert level green, no tsunami flag.

physical.note: Gulf Coast sites from southeast Louisiana to the Florida Big Bend should confirm evacuation zones and failover readiness before Friday. No October typhoon, wildfire or flood events surfaced.
